narrative.zh:
高中同学聚会，大家都很开心。你本打算打车回去，但老同学小王喝了几杯啤酒后坚持要开车送你：『就喝了两杯，没事的！这条路我闭着眼都能开。』

你闻到他身上明显的酒气，心里犯嘀咕。其他同学陆续走了，有的上了朋友的车，有的在叫代驾。

小王已经把车发动了，在等你上车。外面下着雨，打车软件显示排队需要40分钟。
narrative.en: High school reunion — everyone's having a great time. You planned to take a taxi, but your old friend Xiao Wang insists on driving you after a few beers: 'Just two drinks, I'm fine! I could drive this road blindfolded.' You smell alcohol on him. Other classmates are leaving — some with designated drivers, some calling rides. Xiao Wang has already started his car. It's raining. The ride app shows a 40-minute wait.

scenes.image_prompt: Night scene outside a restaurant, rain falling, a car with engine running, a person hesitating between getting in and calling a ride, neon lights reflecting on wet pavement

text.zh: 坚决不上车：『你喝酒了不能开车，我帮你叫代驾，钱我出。』
text.en: Firmly refuse: 'You've been drinking. Let me call you a designated driver — my treat.'

consequence.zh: 小王开始还有点不高兴，觉得你不信任他。你打开手机给他看了酒驾的处罚标准——暂扣驾照6个月、罚款2000元，如果醉驾还要追究刑责。他沉默了，最后同意了叫代驾。路上他对你说：『谢谢你拦住我。我刚才确实喝了不少，只是自己感觉不到。』你们的友情反而更深厚了。
consequence.en: Xiao Wang is initially annoyed. You pull up the drunk driving penalties on your phone — 6-month license suspension, 2000 yuan fine, criminal liability if over the legal limit. He goes quiet, then agrees to the designated driver. On the way, he says: 'Thanks for stopping me. I had more than I realized.' Your friendship actually grows stronger.

text.zh: 虽然担心，但还是上了车——毕竟下雨天打车太难了
text.en: Get in despite the worry — it's raining and rides are scarce

consequence.zh: 车开了不到10分钟，在一个路口被交警拦下。吹气检测结果显示小王属于饮酒驾车。驾照被暂扣6个月，罚款2000元，还要参加7天的交通安全教育。你虽然只是乘客，但那种后怕一直挥之不去——万一出了事故呢？你甚至都不敢往下想。
consequence.en: Within 10 minutes, you're pulled over at a checkpoint. Xiao Wang blows over the legal limit. License suspended for 6 months, 2000 yuan fine, 7-day traffic safety course. You were just a passenger, but the fear lingers — what if there had been an accident? You don't even want to think about it.

text.zh: 建议小王叫代驾，同时表示可以和他一起等，聊聊天
text.en: Suggest calling a designated driver and offer to wait together and chat

consequence.zh: 你们在车上等代驾的20分钟里，回忆了很多高中往事。代驾来了之后，你坐他的车一起回家。路上你看到前方正好有交警在查酒驾——你们相视一笑，都有一种劫后余生的感觉。有时候，最好的选择不一定是『不喝酒』，而是『喝了酒就绝对不碰方向盘』。
consequence.en: During the 20-minute wait, you reminisce about high school. When the designated driver arrives, you ride together. Ahead, you spot a DUI checkpoint. You exchange a look of relief. Sometimes the best choice isn't 'don't drink' — it's 'if you drink, absolutely don't touch the wheel.'
